title: 第30章 下周进组
content_zh:
让刘艺菲比较欣慰的是，妈妈并没有当场同意。

    但回家之后，妈妈一直在查成立电影公司的事情，让刘艺菲的心情又不太美妙起来。

    妈妈还是心动了啊。

    可惜自己人微言轻，被认为是小孩子，她的意见都没有被采纳。

    看着妈妈的兴趣越来越大，刘艺菲就想到了当初的自己。

    自己也是这么被谷川给骗到的。

    可自己只是被骗6315美元而已，妈妈可能整个人都被谷川给骗走啊！

    一直忙忙碌碌，很快就到了三月。

    刘小丽不顾刘艺菲的阻拦，还是执意和谷川一起成立了一个电影公司，并且占股51%。

    合资公司，中方占股必须大于51%，这是底线。

    既然占这么多股，那刘小丽肯定会拿出钱来啊，虽然谷川百般拒绝，说刘姐可以不用出钱的，出个名就行。

    刘艺菲也百般阻拦。

    妈妈，你被谷川骗个人也就行了，就不要再被骗钱了。

    但刘小丽不听，她不能占自己弟弟的便宜啊，哪有白拿那么多股份的道理？

    谷川无奈，刘艺菲也无奈。

    只是刘艺菲看到谷川的无奈之后，恨不得把他吃了。

    妈妈还是太单纯了，自己只是说几句谷川的坏话而已，妈妈就说‘破坏公司团结的话不要讲’。

    成立公司是一个麻烦事，尤其是合资公司。

    这个流程是很长的，就算是加急去办，需要的时间也短不了。

    谷川想着把公司弄好再拍电影，但明显有人等不了那么久。

    “谷导，我到底什么时候可以进组啊？”

    刚到三月，范小胖便急不可耐地给谷川打电话。

    谷川只是温声对着她安抚道：“快了快了，很快就能进组。”

    “快了是多快？”范小胖在家里已经待得有些焦虑了。

    她已经很长时间没有工作了。

    因为电影增肥的事情，还和谷川签了合同，没有谷川的允许，不能出现在公众场合。

    缺乏了那么长时间的曝光，还没有戏拍，范小胖感觉自己要疯掉了。

    如果这部电影没有成功，那对她的职业生涯造成的影响会非常大。

    可成功还是失败先不谈。

    现在的谷川，好像一直没有启动电影的心思。

    “下周。”谷川对范小胖保证道：“下周绝对进组。”

    “下周复下周，下周何其多。”范小胖咬着牙说道。
content_en:
What made Liu Yifei more gratified was that her mother did not agree on the spot.

    But after returning home, her mother kept investigating the establishment of a film company, which made Liu Yifei's mood not so good again.

    Mom was still moved.

    It's a pity that she is soft-spoken and is considered a child, so her opinions are not accepted.

    Seeing her mother's growing interest, Liu Yifei thought of herself back then.

    He was also deceived by Tanichuan in this way.

    But I was only defrauded of 6,315 US dollars, and my mother might have been defrauded entirely by Tanigawa!

    It’s been a busy time and it’s March soon.

    Despite Liu Yifei's obstruction, Liu Xiaoli insisted on setting up a film company with Tanichuan and held 51% of the shares.

    In a joint venture, the Chinese party must hold more than 51% of the shares. This is the bottom line.

    Since she holds so many shares, Liu Xiaoli will definitely pay for it. Although Tanichuan refused in every possible way, saying that Sister Liu doesn't have to pay for it, she just needs to be famous.

    Liu Yifei also blocked her in every possible way.

    Mom, it’s okay for you to be defrauded by Tanichuan. Don’t be defrauded of money again.

    But Liu Xiaoli didn't listen. She couldn't take advantage of her brother. How could there be any reason to get so many shares for nothing?

    Tanichuan was helpless, and so was Liu Yifei.

    But after Liu Yifei saw Tanichuan's helplessness, she wanted to eat him.

    My mother was still too naive. She just said a few bad words about Tanigawa, and she said, 'Don't say anything that will damage the unity of the company.'

    Setting up a company is a hassle, especially a joint venture.

    This process is very long, and even if it is done urgently, it will take a long time.

    Tanichuan thought about getting the company ready before making movies, but it was obvious that some people couldn't wait that long.

    "Director Gu, when can I join the group?"

    As soon as March arrived, Fan Xiaopang called Gu Chuan impatiently.

    Tanichuan just comforted her in a warm voice: "Come on, come on, you'll be in the group soon."

    "How fast is it?" Fan Xiaopang was already feeling a little anxious at home.

    She hasn't worked for a long time.

    Because of the weight gain for the movie, he also signed a contract with Tanigawa. Without Tanichuan's permission, he cannot appear in public.

    Without such a long period of exposure and filming, Fan Xiaopang felt like he was going crazy.

    If the film hadn't been a success, the impact on her career would have been huge.

    But let’s not talk about success or failure.

    Now Tanichuan seems to have no intention of starting a movie.

    "Next week." Gu Chuan promised Fan Xiaopang: "I will definitely join the group next week."

    "Next week after week, there are so many next weeks." Fan Xiaopang said through gritted teeth.
title_en: Chapter 30 Join the group next week
